description: Check async job status by callback key (eq_callback/check). Many InvAPI operations (power on/off, order, reinstall, snapshots) return {"result":"OK","callback":"<key>"}. Pass that key here: result="Not ready" — still running; result="OK" — finished (key then expires). Server deploy can take 10–30 minutes. If the client sent progressToken, emits notifications/progress.

key.description: Callback key from an async operation response

name: check_task
